description:
The 'TreatmentPlanner' project depends on a legacy library 'dose-engine.jar' located in the project's lib folder. You need to inspect the proprietary dose calculation formulas in the 'DoseCalculator' class, but the source code is not currently attached (you only see 'Source not found' or compiled byte code).

A source code archive has been provided at '/home/ga/Downloads/dose-engine-src.zip'.

Your task:
1. Open the 'TreatmentPlanner' project in Eclipse.
2. Configure the project's Java Build Path to attach the source zip ('dose-engine-src.zip') to the 'dose-engine.jar' library.
3. Verify the source is attached by opening 'com.dosimetry.engine.DoseCalculator' to ensure the Java code is visible.

Note: The source attachment must use the provided zip file.
